lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for the <c:ffff00>legs<c> <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>.

Measures the physical ability to move and control
posture.
The higher the value, the more <c:ffff00>defense power<c> and
<c:ffff00>evasion power<c> rise.

With a <c:ffff00>Berserk<c> <c:ffff00>attack<c>, Mobility is added to <c:ffff00>{{power}}<c>.
